name: helix-bot
description: Standalone Discord bot for developer communities — moderation, thread tickets, scaffolding, and zero-AI code intelligence

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Discord Bot Token from Developer Portal (Bot tab -> Reset Token)

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: Discord Application Client ID (General Information -> Application ID)

DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Discord OAuth2 Client Secret (OAuth2 -> General -> Client Secret) for Web Dashboard login

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for signing NextAuth session cookies (generated automatically)

HELIX_DEFAULT_PREFIX.description: Default bot command prefix (customizable per-guild via >set prefix)
